blocks.orig: Kili Villa or Kilimanjaro Luxury Retreats is a luxury accommodation between Arusha and Moshi. It consists of 5 villas with 5 bedrooms each. The villas are decorated in an African design in combination with colonial-style furniture, and built around a central private courtyard boasting a living and dining room, kitchen and service staff. They can be booked separately, so you and your group have a complete villa at your disposal. A campfire, a swimming pool, and a cosy wood stove make your stay here extremely comforting. Besides, the lodge offers a polo field, an 18-hole golf course, horse riding, wildlife on the terrain and even an airstrip. All of which allows you to stay for a few days and explore, and to fly directly to Zanzibar from the airstrip at the end of your stay!
